Geographic focus:
Germany (Bergheim/western Germany, Brandenburg/eastern Germany, Leipzig/Halle); Europe

Temporal focus:
T1. Historical report [YES] — reports on attacks that occurred Tuesday Sept 1
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — ongoing sabotage threat to grid infrastructure implies near-term vulnerability
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

Synopsis:
German authorities are investigating a second sabotage incident targeting electricity grid infrastructure — a substation attack in Bergheim (western Germany) and rocket-delivered conductive material damaging power lines in Brandenburg (eastern Germany). Local power supply was reportedly unaffected. The incidents occur amid heightened geopolitical tension, with Berlin simultaneously accusing Russia of orchestrating a drone attack on a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport. The pattern suggests a coordinated, escalating campaign of hybrid warfare targeting German critical energy infrastructure.
